name: load-not-fault
description: A marketing send quadruples traffic and checkout saturates at its HPA ceiling. Nothing is broken, a harmless release sits in the window, and a rollback would make it worse. Tests whether the agent can conclude that there is no faulty component.

incident.symptom: checkout error rate above SLO (over 5% for 10 minutes)
